example:
import { HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent } from "@godxjp/ui/data-display";

<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger>@yamada</HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent>山田太郎 — 経理部</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>
name: HoverCard
related: Tooltip (short text label, not rich content)
tagline: Radix hover card — a rich popover shown on hover/focus of a trigger (for sighted-pointer affordances; not a replacement for Tooltip's short text).
usage: DO use for RICH preview content (a card, avatar + bio); for short plain-text hints use Tooltip.
DON'T rely on it for essential info — hover isn't available on touch; provide the same content on click/tap elsewhere.
useCases: Entity preview (customer/account) on a table cell
